{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column again
print("Revenue sample:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Check for $ or commas
print("Rows with $ or commas:")
mask = sales_df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[$,]', na=False)
print(sales_df[mask]['revenue'].head())

# Clean the revenue column: remove $ and commas, then convert to float
# Since we saw some rows have $ or commas, we need to strip them
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=True)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue_clean'].str.replace(',', '', regex=True)

# Convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for errors in conversion
print("Number of NaN after conversion:", sales_df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())

# Display cleaned revenue sample
print("Cleaned revenue sample:")
print(sales_df['revenue_clean'].head())"}
